description: Intercepts API requests matching a URL pattern and makes them return an error status code. Navigates to the page and checks if a fallback UI element appears. Use to answer: does the app show a proper error state when the payment API returns 503?

fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback UI that should appear (e.g., '.error-boundary')

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to intercept (e.g., '**/api/payment**')

response_body.description: Response body to return for intercepted requests

status_code.description: HTTP error status code to return (default: 503)

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking the fallback (default: 2000)

name: simulate_api_failure
